name: FF Futurist
summary: FF Futurist is described by Faraday Future's FF EAI Robotics as a full-size professional humanoid robot for reception, hospitality, commercial services, manufacturing, healthcare and university research. The maker's page offers pre-order or enquiry and shows two different prices; no specifications are stated.
specs_note: OWNER-APPROVED 2026-10-31 (Robert Konecny, in thread, PR #223); unpublished, publication is a separate decision. All values verbatim from https://robotics.ff.com/us/ff-futurist/ (observed 2026-10-31). No specifications are stated in the page markup; all specs null. commercial_status left UNKNOWN: the page offers 'Preorder / Inquire' (recorded as a PREORDER availability offer) but states no status word to map. PRICE CONFLICT KEPT, NOT RESOLVED: the same page states two prices in two places: JSON-LD product offer 'Starting price; skill package additional.' 34990 USD, and the site robotics menu 'FF Futurist - From $84,990'. The same menu lists 'FF Master Ultra - From $34,990', so the 34,990 figure may be misplaced; not inferred, owner to decide. The offer is recorded as a RANGE only because the schema allows one offer per seller/region/type; FF does not publish a range. Two evidence rows carry the two statements.

pricing_offers.note: CONFLICT: two different prices stated on the same maker page (34,990 and 84,990 USD, both 'starting'). Not a range published by FF; see specs_note. Skill package additional per the JSON-LD statement.
